features.name: Create Power Automate Flows with Copilot
features.description: Allows users to build Power Automate flows directly inside Business Central using natural language descriptions. Users describe what they want to automate, copilot suggests flow steps, and users fill in necessary parameters to complete the automation.
features.status_evidence_quote: this feature is coming as preview later in this wave
caveats: Initially available only for Business Central set as English language
Initially available only for Power Automate environments based in USA
Availability in other regions will be added later

features.name: Power Automate Templates for Business Central
features.description: Power Platform provides more than 70 templates for Business Central that cover various scenarios, allowing users to create flows without starting from scratch.
caveats: Templates cover some scenarios but not everything

features.name: Power Platform AI Features
features.description: Power Platform has been infused with AI capabilities since 2019 with multiple AI-related features integrated across the platform.
